info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Weather Alerts Severitys-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Severity API provides critical information about the severity levels of weather alerts issued by meteorological authorities. Users can access data regarding various alert categories, helping them to assess risks and prepare for severe weather conditions. This API is particularly useful for app developers, emergency services, and organizations that rely on timely weather information to safeguard communities and assets. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance end-user awareness of potential hazards and support informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint returns the severity levels associated with alerts within the system. Use this information to categorize and prioritize alerts based on their severity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the required parameters for retrieving alert severity details. It must conform to the defined schema and should include all necessary attributes to ensure a successful fetch operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the alert severity data.

ListWeatherAlertsSeveritysRequest.description: Represents the severity level of an alert in the system. This is used in the request body for the GET operations concerning alerts.
